# When Claude Code breaks silently on Windows

> Checks which of 40 silent Windows failure modes for Claude Code and Codex CLI reproduce on this PC.

`irm https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/doctor.ps1 | iex`

## Claude Code hooks

- [A Claude Code PreToolUse hook lets the write through when it times out](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h01.html)
- [A PowerShell hook called with -Command does not block Claude Code](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h02.html)
- [No Claude Code hook runs at all (disableAllHooks is still set)](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h03.html)
- [A Python deny hook lets Claude Code write into a folder with a non-ASCII (Japanese) name](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h04.html)
- [A Claude Code hook path written with backslashes never starts, and the write goes through (exit code 127)](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h05.html)
- [Start Claude Code in a repo subfolder and the hooks in the root .claude/settings.json do not run](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h17.html)
- [Start Claude Code under a junction and the working folder is silently replaced by the real path (hooks too)](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h19.html)
- [If a hook's .ps1 file is missing, writes go through even with onFailure: block](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h21.html)
- [A Git Bash hook that compares $PWD with file_path treats even files inside the project as outside on Windows](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h23.html)

## Claude Code tools and CLAUDE.md

- [Writing through a Windows 8.3 short name makes Claude Code drop the original file name](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h06.html)
- [Stopping a background Bash task in Claude Code with TaskStop leaves the processes started with & or a pipe running](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h07.html)
- [After claude -w -p exits, the git worktree stays locked and cannot be removed](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h08.html)
- [A Claude Code Bash command containing $$( is stopped by the dangerous-removal check](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h09.html)
- [On Windows, Claude Code's Bash tool turns \\ (two backslashes) into one](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h10.html)
- [On Windows, a cd into %TEMP% in Claude Code's Bash tool is undone on the next call](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h11.html)
- [Claude Code's PowerShell tool goes back to the start folder on the next call after cd](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h12.html)
- [claude -p --json-schema silently stops working with an --agent that restricts tools (still reports success)](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h13.html)
- [On Windows, Claude Code's Bash tool does not run commands longer than about 7,400 characters (the error says a quote is unmatched)](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h14.html)
- [A partial Read of a subdirectory CLAUDE.md silently stops the rest of it from loading](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h15.html)
- [On Windows, Claude Code's Edit and Write silently change the letter case of the file name](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h16.html)
- [On Windows, Claude Code skips a subfolder's CLAUDE.md when the path's drive letter is lowercase (c:\)](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h18.html)
- [Claude Code's PowerShell tool reports success as failure because of an earlier command's exit code](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h20.html)
- [Claude Code's Edit and Write silently strip trailing whitespace outside .md files (tabs-to-spaces just deletes the tabs)](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h22.html)
- [Claude Code's Grep returns No files found for a */ glob when searching below the working folder](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/h24.html)

## PowerShell, Python, cmd

- [PowerShell returns exit code 1 when the script exited with 2](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/t01.html)
- [The second value passed with PowerShell -File disappears without an error](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/t02.html)
- [With PowerShell -File, a,b stays one string instead of an array](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/t03.html)
- [Non-ASCII text piped through PowerShell to claude -p, python or git arrives as ?](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/t04.html)
- [Output from python or claude turns into mojibake in a PowerShell variable](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/t05.html)
- [Python works by hand but crashes with UnicodeEncodeError (cp932) under Task Scheduler or redirection](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/t06.html)
- [PYTHONIOENCODING is set, but python -I ignores it](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/t07.html)
- [A UTF-8 .ps1 with non-ASCII text and no BOM fails to parse or prints mojibake in PowerShell 5.1](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/t08.html)
- [A .cmd / .bat file runs its comment text as commands](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/t09.html)
- [$variables in a powershell -Command one-liner vanish before it runs](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/t10.html)
- [Get-ChildItem -Include is ignored and every file comes back](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/t11.html)
- [Markdown backticks inside PowerShell "..." turn into newlines and tabs](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/t12.html)
- [A log that is being written shows 0 bytes in PowerShell on Windows](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/t13.html)
- [claude -p --allowedTools swallows the prompt after it](https://cart231-ffly-b.github.io/cc-win-symptoms/en/t14.html)
